>hail the Unabomber!

A lot of people think I am nuts for admiring the Unabomber.  I am nuts, of course,
but Ted was absolutely right when he wrote:

   "In order to get our message before the public with some chance
    of making a lasting impression, we've had to kill people."

When I read that passage it stuck in my brain and made me realize that the Unabomber
was absolutely sane.  If he hadn't killed anyone I would never have read the essay.

Diablo
